Creating a Voxel Engine with OpenGL | Walker McGilvary
I've laid the foundation for a voxel engine by integrating model importing with STB and implementing advanced lighting effects for the rendered voxels. This first step marks the beginning of my journey with OpenGL and showcases the potential of realistic lighting in voxel-based computer graphics.
